title: Integrating dark fermentation and electrohydrogenesis for enhanced biohydrogen production from food waste
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00571J, Review Article

Anam Jalil, Hikmatullah Ahmadi, Fabrice Ndayisenga, Sohail Khan, Atif Ahmad, Xiangyang Wang, Zhisheng Yu
This review discusses DF–MEC systems for hydrogen production from food waste, highlighting issues of VFAs, hydrogen suppression, and energy efficiency, and examining microbial advances, electrode materials, and pathways to scalability.
